name: Echo CS-4510
blurb: A 45 cc saw: 16″ and 18″ bars on .325″ chain, .050″ gauge, 66–72 drive links per Echo's own chart.
intro: The Echo CS-4510 is a 45 cc saw. Echo lists 16″ and 18″ bars for the CS-4510, on .325″ pitch .050″ chain. This is the step up from 3/8″ low-profile: a different pitch, so the loops are not interchangeable with the CS-310 family.

sources.title: ECHO chainsaws catalog (Jan 2023) — “Bars and Chains” chart: bar and chain part numbers, drive-link count, gauge, pitch and file size per saw; saw specification tables
